items.text: - For now, the ELevate project supports only CentOS repositories. It doesn't support other third-party (external) repositories. - Some CentOS 7 packages can remain after the upgrade.

sections.heading: Install ELevate packages

items.text: 1. Ensure your machine is connected to the appropriate BLCSE Alma ELevate7 mirror. Alma ELevate7 Client Repository Configuration

4. Open the leapp_upgrade_repositories.repo file and use an editor tool of choice, for example vi or mcedit, to replace baseurl link for each repository with a local AlmaLinux mirror directory. Below is what this file should look like.

items.code: [almalinux8baseos-internal] name=AlmaLinux8 - BaseOS baseurl=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/almalinux8baseos/ enabled=1 gpgcheck=1 gpgkey=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/gpgkeys/RPM-GPG-KEY-AlmaLinux [almalinux8appstream-internal] name=AlmaLinux8 - AppStream baseurl=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/almalinux8appstream/ enabled=1 gpgcheck=1 gpgkey=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/gpgkeys/RPM-GPG-KEY-AlmaLinux [almalinux8PowerTools-internal] name=AlmaLinux 8 - PowerTools baseurl=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/almalinux8PowerTools enabled=1 gpgcheck=1 gpgkey=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/gpgkeys/RPM-GPG-KEY-AlmaLinux [almalinux8HighAvailability-internal] name=AlmaLinux 8 - HighAvailability baseurl=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/almalinux8HighAvailability enabled=1 gpgcheck=1 gpgkey=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/gpgkeys/RPM-GPG-KEY-AlmaLinux [almalinux8ResilientStorage-internal] name=AlmaLinux 8 - ResilientStorage baseurl=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/almalinux8ResilientStorage enabled=1 gpgcheck=1 gpgkey=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/gpgkeys/RPM-GPG-KEY-AlmaLinux [almalinux8extras-internal] name=AlmaLinux8 - Extras baseurl=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/almalinux8extras/ enabled=1 gpgcheck=1 gpgkey=https://apensupport.blcse.mil/repos/rpm/gpgkeys/RPM-GPG-KEY-AlmaLinux

items.text: 5. Once you've edited the leapp_upgrade_repositories.repo file to match your local mirror, you can start the migration to AlmaLinux 8.

sections.heading: Perform the migration

items.text: Warning! The preupgrade check will fail as the default install doesn't meet all requirements for migration.

2. Review the Leapp utility created /var/log/leapp/leapp-report.txt file containing possible problems and recommended solutions. This summary report will help you get a picture of whether it is possible to continue the upgrade.

Note: In certain configurations, Leapp generates /var/log/leapp/answerfile with true/false questions. Leapp utility requires answers to all these questions in order to proceed with the upgrade. View ELevate Frequent Issues for a list of common issues found.
4. After reboot, a new entry in GRUB called ELevate-Upgrade-Initramfs will appear. The system will be automatically booted into it. You can see how the update process goes in the console.
